item.title: Ramadan, Lent begin today
item.description: MUSLIMS and Christians in Nigeria, on Wednesday, February 18, joined their counterparts globally to commence the Islamic holy month of Ramadan and Lent respectively. item.title: FCT poll: Police restrict movement from 6am to 6pm
item.description: THE Nigeria Police Force, Federal Capital Territory Command, has announced the deployment of officers and assets across the nation’s capital ahead of the Area Council elections scheduled for Saturday, February 21.
